//AzureAd: Entra ID sign-in. Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json, which is gitignored - never here. See docs/entra-id-setup.md.

Toolkit.//Mode: InProcess (reader on this machine), Agent (reader on the desk, ICP agent there) or Off (typed in). See docs/deployment.md.
Toolkit.//: Must contain config_li and config_ag. Set this to your machine's path.
Toolkit.//NativeDirectory: Only needed if the native toolkit DLLs are not beside the app; the build copies them there.
Toolkit.//Agent: Mode=Agent only. TrustedSignerThumbprints is the control that makes a browser-supplied read trustworthy - see docs/deployment.md.
